profile.headline: Full-stack development, machine learning, UI/UX design | IS + CS @ BYU | MS CS @ USU | Sandbox Fellow

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Delivered department-wide Angular training on signals, observables, and new features in Angular v20
Added a Django admin interface for map uploads, enabling the UX team to manage assets without developer involvement
Developed Angular-based citation generator that reduced citation creation time by 95% and ensured standards-compliant output

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Overhauled UI/UX in Next.js + Supabase, eliminating usability friction and cutting customer support needs by 60%
Built analytics dashboards (Next.js, Drizzle ORM, Supabase), so managers can visualize skill growth and adoption trends
Drove 60% sales increase by transforming app usability, reducing support needs, and improving professionalism/saleability of app
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Full-Stack Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · User Experience Design (UED)

positions.title: Angular Developer
positions.description:
-I built the page on the library website that helps patrons find places and materials in the library (lib.byu.edu/floormaps)
-Partnered with UX designers, translating Figma prototypes into production-ready features
-Developed deep, production-ready Angular expertise through daily structured mentorship with a senior developer and obsessive study of documentation
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language)
